\begin{itemize}
 \item \verb|\SUBTRACTfunction{\f1}{\f2}{\newSubFun}|
 $F(t)= f1 - f2$
 \item \verb|\PRODUCTfunction{\f1}{\f2}{\newProdFun}|
 $F(t)= f1 * f2$
 \item \verb|\SCALEfunction{num}{\func}{\ScFunc}|
 $F(t) = num * func$
\end{itemize}
